_comment_about_this_file: This file mirrors exactly what the backend emits on the 'audit_trail' Socket.io event.
So the top-level value is always an ARRAY — the 50 most recent audit events.
Each object in the array is one audit event.
There are only two possible values for 'signature_status':
'VERIFIED'       — a Solana batch was successfully anchored (good news)
'FRAUD_DETECTED' — a node was caught sending tampered data (bad news)
Events are ordered oldest → newest (append-only log).
In React you would usually reverse this to show newest first in a list.
_comment_about_timestamps: 'timestamp' comes from the L2 node (when the sensor reading was taken).
'logged_at' is added by L3 (when L3 wrote the event to its in-memory log).
Both are Unix milliseconds. Use: new Date(logged_at).toLocaleString() to display them.
_comment_signature_status: VERIFIED means the Solana transaction went through. Data is trustworthy.
_comment_solana_link: Click this URL to view the actual transaction on Solana's block explorer. null when no transaction was submitted yet.
_comment_evidence: Human-readable description of what happened. Always present.
_comment_timestamp_ms: When the sensor reading was taken (milliseconds since Unix epoch, from L2 node).
_comment_node: Which L2 node reported or detected this event.
_comment_device_id: Which physical sensor device this event is about.
_comment_batch_id: The Solana transaction signature. Only present on VERIFIED events, never on FRAUD_DETECTED.
_comment_logged_at: When L3 wrote this event to its log (milliseconds since Unix epoch). Always present.

_comment_about_fraud_event: This is a FRAUD_DETECTED event — the most important kind.
It means one L2 node caught another sending data with a broken HMAC signature.
The 'node' field is the ACCUSER (honest), not the liar.
The lying node's URL would appear in the topology as status=COMPROMISED.
'solana_link' here points to the BFT dispute transaction —
permanent on-chain proof that the fraud happened.
evidence: HMAC_MISMATCH: value=42.7 does NOT match HMAC tag for motion-002 — data tampered
_comment_node_fraud: alpha is the honest ACCUSER that detected the fraud. beta (the lying node) will appear as COMPROMISED in the topology.

_comment_null_link: solana_link is null when the BFT dispute transaction has not been submitted to Solana yet. The fraud is still recorded locally.
evidence: REPLAY_ATTACK: timestamp 1740699900000 is older than last accepted 1740700040000 — stale packet
